text: Applying decentralized voting and consensus to RLHF permits human feedback to be verified before it is used to calibrate the Reward Model, which raises the integrity and reliability of the feedback data entering the model.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4855607
